name: Topkapı Sarayı
source: Built for the Istanbul 3D map (Groker, 4 Nov 2026) from OSM footprints and lines (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); present-day state; toy style. Shape references: Doğancan's photos (never textures).

anchor.what: model origin = Adalet Kulesi base (OSM w335402653 centroid), ground level

rotation_meaning: compass bearing of the model +X axis, degrees clockwise from north (model is in map axes: +X east, +Z south)
three_rotation_note: for a map with +X east, +Z south, +Y up
ground: y = 0 everywhere (flat); terrain height is added by the map at the anchor only [the palace hill is not modelled]

heights_m.Bâb-ı Hümâyun: 17 m [doğrulanmadı] (photos: about twice the flanking wall)
heights_m.III. Ahmed Çeşmesi: 6.5 m walls, eaves 2.5 m, domes to ~11 m [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Aya İrini: OSM building:part heights: base 15, arms 22, domes 24 / 29 m
heights_m.Bâbüsselâm: gate 11 m, towers 17 m + caps to ~27 m [doğrulanmadı] (DİA: pentagonal towers, lead conical caps)
heights_m.Adalet Kulesi: 45 m to the tip [T1] Yeni Şafak (42 m in [T2]); shaft/lantern split [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Saray Mutfakları: 9 m walls ([doğrulanmadı]; SALT TASUDOCM0270 plate has no legible dimensions)
heights_m.Harem: 2-4 storeys: 8 / 11.5 / 15 m walls per ~14 m cell (yaklaşık) [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Harem dome: Hünkâr Sofası: r 7.0 m on 11.5 m walls, position from the plan [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Harem dome: III. Murad Has Odası: r 5.5 m on 11.5 m walls, position from the plan [doğrulanmadı] (snapped into the built mass)
heights_m.Harem dome: Valide Sultan Dairesi: r 4.2 m on 8.0 m walls, position from the plan [doğrulanmadı] (snapped into the built mass)
heights_m.Harem dome: Valide Sultan Dairesi (2): r 3.4 m on 11.5 m walls, position from the plan [doğrulanmadı] (snapped into the built mass)
heights_m.Harem dome: Harem Hamamı: r 3.0 m on 15.0 m walls, position from the plan [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Harem dome: Harem Hamamı (2): r 2.6 m on 15.0 m walls, position from the plan [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Harem west wall face: 17 m stone face with brick bands along 125 m of the west edge (stands in for the slope; terrain flat) [doğrulanmadı]

parts: third_court (Arz Odası, Has Oda, Hırka-i Saadet, Fatih Köşkü, III. Ahmed Library, Ağalar Camii, ...)
fourth_court (Bağdat, Revan, Mecidiye, Sofa köşkü, İftariye, Gülhane gate)
sur_sultani (Sur-ı Sultani + Sarayburnu sea walls inside the map, street openings)
left_out: the old Bâb-ı Hümâyun köşk (removed 1867-68; not today)
Darphane and other first-court buildings (stay as map buildings)
footprint_note: map metres (x east, z south); buildings under footprint_map_xz are dropped; trees under both are dropped; OSM towers on the wall line stay as map buildings
layout_reference: Doğancan's Topkapı guidebook plan (reference only): registered to OSM (9 control points, rms 4.1 m) and used for layout and measurement only; not a texture, not shipped
plan_notes: w32396154: OSM outline includes the open stable court (plan A); clipped to the plan roof (2281 -> 1347 m2)
Harem: mass from the plan roof inside the OSM outline (+3 m), courts kept open; 9474 m2 outline -> 6714 m2 built, 2192 m2 courts
Harem: 60 cells, 6 main-room domes + 10 small domes, 14 chimneys, 22 bays, west wall face 125 m
plan roof mass with no OSM building at map (436, 1354), 136 m2: added as a 7.5 m range [doğrulanmadı]
